description: NIST MBE PMI fully-toleranced test case 10, the AP203 geometry-only edition (ADR-0026 §1): its cylinder faces bounded by two closed curves and no seam — a circle and a closed B-spline, or two circles — are joined by a seam (real/seamless-cylinder-band); eight cone faces bounded by their base circle alone, the apex implicit, fail the reader's checker
